title: DDA P4 Chariow Billing and Entitlement Contract
description: Provider adapter contract for Chariow checkout and signed Pulses. It is inactive until server secrets, product mapping and a deployed HTTPS BFF are configured.

provider.name: chariow
provider.signature: HMAC-SHA256 over untouched raw body, x-chariow-signature=sha256=<hex>

membershipModel.identityLink: server-created checkout_intent or verified customer reference
membershipModel.productMapping: explicit allowlist of Chariow product IDs; never product name matching
membershipModel.entitlementGrant: active status from an allowlisted product only
membershipModel.refundPolicy: revoke through provider event or an explicit server reconciliation job before access is removed

acceptedPulseEvents.successful.sale: activate mapped Premium membership after idempotent persistence
acceptedPulseEvents.abandoned.sale: record pending/abandoned checkout; never grant access
acceptedPulseEvents.failed.sale: record failed checkout; never grant access

processingRules: capture raw request bytes before JSON parsing
deduplicate by delivery ID before applying a transition
persist the event before asynchronous entitlement processing
derive owner_id from the authenticated account or a server-created checkout intent
return 2xx only after the delivery is durably accepted
notYetActivated: no Chariow API key is committed
no production product ID is committed
no payment is made by this repository change
no recurring-subscription event is assumed unless Chariow enables and documents it for the store
requiredSecurityTests: raw body bytes used for HMAC
duplicate delivery ID does not reapply transition
failed or abandoned sale cannot grant Premium
expired or revoked license removes entitlement
checkout redirect is not treated as payment confirmation
